skilling.soloHardcore: Ordinary Tempoross hazards don't deal Hitpoints damage. External poison or self damage can still kill.
skilling.hardcoreGroup: Ordinary skilling hazards don't deal Hitpoints damage; independent death may cost a life.
skilling.ultimate: Use supplies carried or available at the dock. Check independent damage before entry.

warmth.soloHardcore: Zero Warmth can be lethal. Bring recovery.
warmth.hardcoreGroup: Zero Warmth can be lethal and cost a group life.
warmth.ultimate: Use warm gear and carried/site warmth recovery.

safe_hc_unsafe_hcg.soloHardcore: Encounter death is safe for solo Hardcore in this bracket; outside access hazards remain.
safe_hc_unsafe_hcg.hardcoreGroup: An encounter death costs a group life. Exclude from default route.
safe_hc_unsafe_hcg.ultimate: Check the specific instance/deathbank behavior; never port Hardcore safety into a storage claim.

gauntlet_danger.soloHardcore: A Gauntlet death loses Hardcore status, even with supplied equipment.
gauntlet_danger.hardcoreGroup: A Gauntlet death can cost a group life.
gauntlet_danger.ultimate: A Gauntlet death can clear stored retrieval items even though the encounter supplies its own gear.

unsafe_raid.soloHardcore: In-raid deaths can lose Hardcore status. Entry-mode resets are not protection. Skip by default.
unsafe_raid.hardcoreGroup: A death can cost a group life, including Entry. Do not rely on further attempts.
unsafe_raid.ultimate: Theatre Entry and other raids have different recovery rules. Verify wipe, logout and stored-kit behavior at that difficulty.

wilderness.soloHardcore: Wilderness approach or fight can lose status through PvP or PvM.
wilderness.hardcoreGroup: Wilderness PvP or PvM can cost a group life.
wilderness.ultimate: Wilderness carries particular carried-item and retrieval-storage loss. Explicit opt-in only.

quest_variant.soloHardcore: Use documented rematch. Quest fights and rematches can differ in death handling.
quest_variant.hardcoreGroup: Check each rematch. Galvek and Glough are listed safe; hold Seren for mode confirmation.
quest_variant.ultimate: Check exact replay and second-death mechanics before planning.

preparation.text: Use the points still needed on this character. Start with ready tasks, then compare active Slayer, boss unlocks and exact raid modes.
